briefdescription.para: aring-style adapter for arbitrary-precision real intervals, backed by MPFI.

detaileddescription.para: ElementType is __mpfi_struct a closed interval [lo, hi] of MPFR endpoints, so arithmetic returns rigorous containing intervals. mPrecision sets the per-endpoint MPFR precision; characteristic is 0. ringID = ring_RRi. Forms the real component of ARingCCi.
